newsitem.title: USA: General Binding Q4 net climbs with sales.
newsitem.headline: General Binding Q4 net climbs with sales.

text.p: General Binding Corp said Monday its new business strategies and acquisitions helped fourth-quarter net income rise by 25 percent in the fourth quarter ended December 31.
The company said earnings reached $$6.7 million, up from $5.4 million one year ago. Sales in the period reached $142.2 million, compared to $118.5 million in 1995.
General Binding said results did not include effects from its Quartet Manufacturing Co purchase, which closed January 1.
General Binding is a document finishing company. Its shares were trading up 5/8 Monday at 31-1/4.
